$Comment: Marn's standing trim order, for a finished sawyer: the specialty cuts and the offcuts, milled
AND delivered.
Repeat.Reset with an Every block is a SPAN cadence rather than a calendar one, which is what
three hours needs: a calendar has no three-hour boundary, so Period cannot express it. Author
Every for any window that is not Daily or Weekly, and never both in the same Reset. Widen or
narrow the Hours here to change how often the order comes round; the engine buckets anything
shorter than a day as repeatable rather than daily, so the quest list badges it that way and a
finish-so-many-dailies objective elsewhere will not count it.
It opens once A Finer Edge is claimed, so it runs beside the Standing Order for a player who has
finished the sawmill chain, and the two never pay the same thing. All five steps sit on
Order 1, so they run together. cut_decorative and cut_ornate count the two specialty cuts the
crouch-and-use picker offers, any species on CONTAINS and qualified to the Sawmill, so lumber
from a hand bench does not count; pull_offcuts counts plant fibre the mill sheds as a byproduct,
exact id and Sawmill-qualified the same way. deliver_trim and deliver_offcuts hand in to Marn
only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'): decorative planks of any species on CONTAINS, and bark by exact id,
another Sawmill byproduct. One session at the mill covers all five: the cut steps fill the delivery
of trim, and the offcuts of the same shift fill both byproduct steps. Raise or lower any of the
five Amounts to change how long one order takes to fill.
The payout is four Lootable rewards, one per concern, so a retune is an edit to one small table
rather than a hunt through a long one. Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Pay is the wage: Woodcutting level picks
the tier and Woodcutting luck decides how well that tier's run went. Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Supply
keeps the worker in hatchets and repair kits off their level alone, plus a small luck-driven
sapling and light bonus. Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Finds is the occasional extra.
Mmo_Woodcutters_Kit carries the only rolls anywhere that pay the woodcutter's kit. All four sit
in the Claim bucket, so every roll happens when the player collects; nothing in this file needs
to change to make the order more or less generous.
Listing puts it in the misc category on the same shelf as the Standing Order, one place after
it.
Name: Trim_Work
